Valdez Salmon Fishing in Prince William Sound

Head out from Valdez for salmon in Prince William Sound. Take a charter or make a boat trip of your own on Alaska's coast.

About this water

The fishery source record for Prince William Sound / Valdez, United States, identifies Coho salmon, Lingcod, Chinook salmon and Pink salmon.

Prince William Sound is a wider research area than a single Valdez departure. Ask the provider to specify the port, launch and target instead of accepting a sound-wide species list as an itinerary. A personal-boat plan also needs its own navigation and return arrangements. Pink and coho salmon appear in the regional evidence, but their presence does not settle the method or the route for your day.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Alaska

Non-residents aged 16 or older need a sport fishing licence. A king salmon stamp is normally required even when you release the fish.

  • 1 day$15 USD
  • 3 days$30 USD
  • 7 days$45 USD
  • 14 days$75 USD
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • King salmon stamp ↗
    Non-residents aged 16 or older who target king salmon, including catch and release, where the fishery is open. Buy online from ADF&G or a licence vendor. A stamp does not override a closure.
  • Charter halibut stamp ↗ · $20 USD
    Charter anglers aged 18 or older who intend to retain halibut in Area 2C or 3A; each trip/day requires a stamp, subject to the GAF exception. Arrange the stamp through the charter guide before fishing.

Rules for this water

  • Apply the NOAA charter halibut size limits and closed days for the actual fishing area; guided and unguided limits differ.
  • Record any retained fish subject to an annual limit; exempt anglers need a free harvest record card.
  • Check the Prince William Sound / Valdez special regulations and emergency orders official regulations ↗

Fishing for tuna or billfish offshore? You may also need a federal permit. US federal rules.
